preconditions.description: The number of towns in Udayland is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each road goes from town i to some other town a_i, where 1 <= a_i <= n and a_i != i.

postconditions.expression: output == number of ways to flip some set of roads such that the resulting network is not confusing
postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to flip some set of roads so that the resulting network is not confusing.
